game.name: History Channel : Civil War : A Nation Divided, The (USA)
game.desc: The History Channel: Civil War: A Nation Divided is a first-person shooter for Xbox 360. The title invites you to discover or rediscover the sad events of the American Civil War (1861-1865). It offers you the opportunity to enlist as a soldier and to go to the famous battlefields that turned the American "Civil War" upside down.
